skill.core.eagleEye.description.advanced:
{Advanced Eagle Eye}

Advanced Eagle Eye gives your hero a 60% chance to learn any spell up to 4th level used in combat. Also, when facing a hero who knows any Advanced magic skill, your hero can cast spells from the same school on the Advanced level.
skill.core.eagleEye.description.basic:
{Basic Eagle Eye}

Basic Eagle Eye gives your hero a 50% chance to learn any spell up to 3rd level used in combat. Also, when facing a hero who knows any Basic magic skill, your hero can cast spells from the same school on the Basic level.
skill.core.eagleEye.description.expert:
{Expert Eagle Eye}

Expert Eagle Eye gives your hero a 70% chance to learn any spell used in combat. Also, when facing a hero who knows any Expert magic skill, your hero can cast spells from the same school on the Expert level.
